requirements.rationale: Complete transactions adjust both required totals by type, while non-Complete transactions adjust neither.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/transaction/transaction.service.ts:128-159 creates and saves exactly one Transaction entity and maps the saved record to the response

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/transaction/transaction.service.ts:80-159 wraps validation, balance synchronization, and the insert in one TypeORM SERIALIZABLE transaction
Lines 81-94 acquire pessimistic write locks on User then Account in deterministic order before balance decisions
Thrown validation or persistence errors leave the transaction callback before commit and TypeORM rolls it back; non-HTTP failures retain the safe HTTP 500 mapping
Mandatory trimmed shop/payment strings and nullable category mapping remain enforced; backend and Docker builds passed
requirements.rationale: The multi-table create operation now has one rollback boundary, explicit isolation, deterministic row locks, and required field mappings.
